description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetBatchContainer class, which is part of a streaming provider implementation using Orleans and ADO.NET. It tests construction, serialization/deserialization, event filtering, request context import, and string rendering functionalities.

classes.name: AdoNetBatchContainerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for AdoNetBatchContainer, using xUnit framework and TestEnvironmentFixture to set up serializer and environment.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A record used for testing serialization; annotated with serializer and alias attributes.

classes.name: OtherModel
classes.description: Another test record type used for filtering and serialization testing.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer_Constructs
methods.description: Tests that AdoNetBatchContainer is correctly constructed with stream id, events, and request context.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer_FromMessage_CreatesContainer
methods.description: Tests that a container can be correctly reconstructed from a serialized message.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer_ToMessagePayload_CreatesPayload
methods.description: Verifies that the message payload correctly serializes the container contents.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer_GetEvents_ThrowsOnHalfBaked
methods.description: Ensures GetEvents throws an exception if called on an improperly initialized container.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer_GetEvents_FiltersEvents
methods.description: Checks that GetEvents filters and returns only events of the requested type along with their sequence tokens.

methods.name: AdoNetBatchContainer_ImportsRequestContext
methods.description: Tests that the request context is correctly imported and accessible in the container.

methods.description: Validates that the container's ToString method produces expected string output.
